summary: Settle whether c_3 3.35% q_0 swing is Taylor-exact or fitting artifact
comment: The c_3 coefficient has flip-flopped four times (b2f908731 → 41b8d4a4c → f4930df95 → c1f7487df/b3c92844d). Latest read (b3c92844d): c_3 = J_Hopf − ℏ_q² is q_0-dependent, NOT Taylor-exact. Open question: is the q_0 dependence the TRUE Taylor structure (i.e. c_3 IS a function of q, not a constant), or is the near-match a fitting artifact masking the real coefficient? Test: compute c_3 at three q_0 anchors (muon-pin, m_p-pin, m_⁴He-pin) to 50 dps; if Taylor-exact, the residual should drop monotonically with truncation order N. **Keystone for the whole c_k ladder** — once settled, c_4–c_7 derivations follow the Habiro recursion (probe-c4-habiro etc).

summary: Derive c_4 canonically via Habiro recursion
comment: Per d6b6e0483 audit: Habiro q-difference equation gives recursive c_k pair-rules. Per PR #1521 (claude/alpha-em-habiro-categorical-1loop-2026-05-30): Habiro element [2]_q·(1−h²α) is the closed fermion loop in fundamental rep. Together these suggest c_4 can be derived from c_2, c_3 (once c_3 is settled) via the recursion. Blocked by probe-c3-q0-stability.

summary: Extend Habiro recursion to c_5, c_6, c_7 (1ppQ target requires N=7)
comment: Per 6ace8153e truncation analysis: each rung buys log₁₀(1/u) ≈ 2.07 digits. N=7 reaches 1 ppQ (10⁻¹⁵). Requires c_2, c_3, c_4 settled first. Once Habiro recursion is verified canonical for c_4, applying it three more steps should reach c_7 — assuming the recursion does not break degree.

summary: Add Lean §3b-cond classes for c_4–c_7 mirroring QbetaC3StructuralFormClass
comment: Per CLAUDE.md §3b-cond: conjectural inputs axiomatised as Lean classes; downstream theorems take class as [Instance] hypothesis. Pattern established by 441c291fc (QbetaC3StructuralFormClass) and be0f45591 (QbetaHabiroTaylorBridgeClass). One class per coefficient that isn't Taylor-exact. Q_β ladder Lean theorem proves: Q_β = product over k of class-instance values.

summary: Bump _precision.py defaults to 70 dps compute / 60 dps output for 1 ppQ headroom
comment: Current defaults: 65 dps compute / 50 dps serialization. For safe 10⁻¹⁵ arithmetic with a 10⁻³⁰ truncation floor, recommend 70 dps compute / 60 dps output. Mechanical change. Should be done early to make all downstream c_k derivations measure at the right precision.
